2609.37567.title: Concealing LLM-Based Multi-Agent Topology via Phantom Structure Injection
2609.37567.paper_summary: Driven by the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for collaborative reasoning over complex tasks. A key design element of MAS is the communication topology, which governs information flow among agents and often encodes proprietary knowledge about the system architecture. However, recent work has shown that such topologies can be inferred even in black-box settings by exploiting semantic dependencies in observable reasoning traces, posing significant risks of intellectual property leakage and exposure of system vulnerabilities. To address this threat, we propose MIRAGE, a topology-concealment framework that preserves the genuine communication topology for task execution while shaping adversary-facing semantic evidence toward a carefully constructed phantom topology. Specifically, MIRAGE operates in three stages: (1) phantom topology synthesis, (2) semantic edge realization, and (3) protected MAS execution. It constructs a phantom topology structurally distinct from the genuine one, materializes phantom edges as plausible semantic dependencies, and suppresses source-specific cues that could reveal genuine edges absent from the phantom topology. Extensive experiments across three topology optimization frameworks and four benchmark datasets demonstrate that MIRAGE substantially reduces the effectiveness of topology inference attacks while largely preserving the task utility of the protected MAS.
2609.37567.paper_summary_zh: 受到大型語言模型（LLMs）快速進步的驅動，基於LLM的多代理系統（MAS）已成為協作推理複雜任務的強大範式。MAS的一個關鍵設計元素是通信拓撲，它管理著代理之間的信息流，並且通常編碼有關系統架構的專有知識。然而，最近的研究顯示，即使在黑箱環境中，也可以通過利用可觀察推理痕跡中的語義依賴關係來推斷這些拓撲，這對知識產權洩漏和系統漏洞的暴露構成了重大風險。為了解決這一威脅，我們提出了MIRAGE，一個拓撲隱蔽框架，旨在保留任務執行的真實通信拓撲，同時將面對對手的語義證據塑造成精心構建的幻影拓撲。具體而言，MIRAGE分為三個階段運作：（1）幻影拓撲合成，（2）語義邊緣實現，以及（3）受保護的MAS執行。它構建了一個在結構上與真實拓撲不同的幻影拓撲，將幻影邊緣具現化為合理的語義依賴關係，並抑制可能揭示真實邊緣的源特定線索，這些真實邊緣在幻影拓撲中缺失。對三個拓撲優化框架和四個基準數據集的廣泛實驗表明，MIRAGE顯著降低了拓撲推斷攻擊的有效性，同時在很大程度上保留了受保護的MAS的任務效用。
